target: Build a runnable demonstration of causal identification using a causal graph and intervention plan. Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.

competency.title: Implement causal identification — few shot
competency.outcome: Build a runnable demonstration of causal identification using a causal graph and intervention plan. Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.

topic_kernel.artifact: a causal graph and intervention plan

competency.practice_task: Produce executable code or a runnable protocol grounded in a causal graph and intervention plan.
competency.setting_constraint: Limit adaptation to a declared small example budget.
required_evidence: executable code or a runnable protocol
Include the example count, selection rule and learning curve.
Report identifiability under stated assumptions with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: controlling for a collider.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of causal identification.
Practice: the artifact passes a new functional case and a failure case.
Measurement: report identifiability under stated assumptions against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for controlling for a collider; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
